## What is measured

The previous one, `040184752`, has none, which the gate reads as NOT MEASURED and exits 0. Its landing record on #22917 says so: "this is the first refresh to write the suite-duration ceiling table".
- **Two queue builds after it, both red on one package:**

  - `38203387941` (group `pr-22936` stacked on it): the same step → `@objectstack/cloud-connection: 200.33s, over its 163.89s ceiling. Slowest file: src/marketplace-install-local-state-machine-exempt.test.ts 10.70s.`

- **Neither PR touches the package.** PR #22931 is `packages/spec` only (one collector in `defineStack`); PR #22936 is `packages/lint` hint text only. `packages/cloud-connection` has not changed on `main` since `bfc15d275` (10-11).
- **The table's own numbers:** `@objectstack/cloud-connection` weighs 81.68 s with a ceiling of 163.89 s (the window's slowest run × 1.25, so about 131 s at most in the window). The queue builds ran it at 2.2× and 2.5× its weight.
- **CONTROL, so it is load and not a constant:** PR #22931's own `Test Core` on its head `70c36c1151` (a `packages/spec` change puts every dependent, `cloud-connection` included, in the affected set) concluded `success`, ceiling step included. `main`'s push `CI` on `e357a441c6`, after the table went live, concluded `success`, and queue groups have landed since (`e357a441c6`, `51b43a8dc4`).

## Why (as read)

- The window behind the ceiling is the refresh's 12 hourly `schedule` runs of CI (per #22923's review record). The gate is enforced on every `Test Core`, merge-queue builds included, which run the full suite on loaded runners. A package whose queue-load time sits near 2× its window time crosses `max × 1.25` on some builds and not others.
- So the ratchet ejects PRs on a measurement of runner load, which is the failure shape #22917 recorded for `shard-timing-drift`.

## Not measured

- Whether other packages sit as close to their ceilings under queue load. Only `cloud-connection` has crossed so far.
- Whether the next queue builds of PR #22931 (re-armed once, `6117898114`) and PR #22936 (re-grouped) pass.

## Direction (not a ruling)

The options are the maintainer's, because `RULED_CEILING_RAISES` needs a ruling URL. They are listed only so the grade can be priced:
- (a) a ruled raise for `@objectstack/cloud-connection`;
- (b) the ceiling's window includes queue-load runs, or the ceiling step reads a queue build at a different factor;
- (c) `cloud-connection`'s slowest files (7–11 s each) get faster.
